title: Aasai Aasaiyai
desc: Brinda's father suffers a heart attack when her elder sister elopes with her boyfriend. Later, Brinda decides to prioritise her family's dreams before her love for Vinod.

title: Gentleman
desc: Kicha is a modern-day Robin Hood, who along with his friend, Mani, steals from the rich to aid the poor. In society, he is a respected man who runs a small business.

title: Narasimha
desc: Rasool Akhtar terrorises the nation when he murders 20 soldiers. Soon, Narasimha, an honest police officer, sets out to foil Rasool's plans.

title: Run
desc: Shiva, who comes to Chennai to pursue higher studies, falls in love with Priya on a bus. However, when he learns that her brother is a gangster, he assesses the stakes involved in pursuing her.

title: Sivappu Manjal Pachai
desc: Rajasekar, a disciplined traffic officer, clashes with Madhan, a spirited street racer. Their rivalry takes a personal turn when Rajasekar's marriage to Madhan's sister creates tension in their lives.
